## Day2
### rsa1
p和q相差过小，开根枚举

exp

```python
import gmpy2
from Crypto.Util.number import *
from sympy import nextprime

c = 
N = 
p1, _ = gmpy2.iroot(N, 2)
while 1:
    if N % p1 == 0:
        break
    p1 = nextprime(p1)
p = p1
q = N // p
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = pow(65537, -1, phi)
m = pow(c, d, N)
print(long_to_bytes(m))
# b'hello'
```

### rsa4
已知dp, dq, p, q，e未知
首先$c^d \equiv m \pmod{n} $，可得方程组
$$
\begin{cases}
c^d \equiv m_1 \pmod{p} & (1) \\
c^d \equiv m_2 \pmod{q} & (2)
\end{cases}
$$

又$ dp \equiv d \pmod{p-1},\quad d = dp + k(p-1) $，所以$c^d \equiv c^{dp + k(p-1)} \equiv c^{dp} \pmod{p} $

dq同理，可得方程组如下，据此可以计算出m1和m2
$$
\begin{cases}
c^{dp} \equiv m_1 \pmod{p} \\
c^{dq} \equiv m_2 \pmod{q}
\end{cases}
$$
然后回去看第一个方程组，由(1)可得$c^d = m_1 + k \cdot p $，两边模q可得$m_2 \equiv m_1 + k \cdot p \pmod{q}$，可以由此求出$k \equiv (m_2 - m_1) \cdot p^{-1} \pmod{q}$，至此c的d次幂求出来了，n已知，模n即可得到m

exp

```python
from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes

p = 
q = 
dq = 
dp = 
c = 

m1 = pow(c, dp, p)
m2 = pow(c, dq, q)
k = (m2 - m1) * pow(p, -1, q) % q
m = (m1 + k * p) % (p * q)
print(long_to_bytes(m))
# b'hello hello '
```

### rsa5
已知dp, n, e

由$ dp \equiv d \pmod{p-1},\quad p-1 | phi(n),\quad e \cdot d \equiv 1 \pmod{phi(n)}$，可$ e \cdot dp \equiv 1 \pmod{p-1}$，即$e \cdot dp = 1 + k(p-1)$

dp和(p-1)数量级相当，因此k和e的数量级也差不多，可爆破，另一方面，由于dp<p-1，所以k<e

exp

```python
from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes, isPrime

n = 
e = 65537
dp = 
c = 

for i in range(1, e):
    tmp1 = (e * dp - 1) % i
    tmp2 = (e * dp - 1) // i + 1
    if isPrime(tmp2) and tmp1 == 0:
        p = tmp2
        break

q = n // p
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = pow(e, -1, phi)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print(long_to_bytes(m))
# b'hlhjkhkhkj'
```

### rsa6

维纳攻击模板题

exp

```python
n = 
e = 
c = 

def wiener_attack(e, n):
    cf = continued_fraction(e / n)
    convergents = cf.convergents()
    for conv in convergents:
        k = conv.numerator()
        d = conv.denominator()
        if k == 0:
            continue
        if (e * d - 1) % k != 0:
            continue
        phi = (e * d - 1) // k
        b = n - phi + 1
        discriminant = b ^ 2 - 4 * n
        if discriminant >= 0:
            sqrt_disc = discriminant.sqrt()
            if sqrt_disc in ZZ:
                p = (b + sqrt_disc) // 2
                q = (b - sqrt_disc) // 2
                if p * q == n:
                    return d
    return None


from Crypto.Util.number import *
d = wiener_attack(e, n)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print(long_to_bytes(int(m)))
# b'moectf{Ez_W1NNer_@AtT@CK}'
```

### rsa7

公式推导，已知
$$
c_1 \equiv (3p + 7q)^{e_1} \mod N \\
c_2 \equiv (2p + 5q)^{e_2} \mod N
$$
变形如下
$$
c_1^{e_2} \equiv (3p + 7q)^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N \\
c_2^{e_1} \equiv (2p + 5q)^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N
$$
同余号右边可以二项式定理展开，交叉项模N就没了，只剩下两项
$$
c_1^{e_2} \equiv (3p)^{e_1\cdot e_2} + (7q)^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N \\
c_2^{e_1} \equiv (2p)^{e_1\cdot e_2} + (5q)^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N
$$
再配一个系数把p或者q消掉一个
$$
c_1^{e_2} \equiv k_1 \cdot p^{e_1\cdot e_2} + k_2 \cdot q^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N \\
c_2^{e_1} \equiv k_3 \cdot p^{e_1\cdot e_2} + k_4 \cdot q^{e_1\cdot e_2} \mod N \\
$$
给上面的式子两边乘一个(k1_inv * k3)然后做差，最后用gcd求即可

exp

```python
from Crypto.Util.number import *
N = 
c1 = 
c2 = 
c = 
e1 = 12886657667389660800780796462970504910193928992888518978200029826975978624718627799215564700096007849924866627154987365059524315097631111242449314835868137
e2 = 12110586673991788415780355139635579057920926864887110308343229256046868242179445444897790171351302575188607117081580121488253540215781625598048021161675697

k1 = pow(3, e1 * e2, N)
k2 = pow(7, e1 * e2, N)
k3 = pow(2, e1 * e2, N)
k4 = pow(5, e1 * e2, N)
c1e2 = pow(c1, e2, N)
c2e1 = pow(c2, e1, N)

tmp = pow(k1, -1, N) * k3 % N
tmp1 = c1e2 * tmp % N
k22 = k2 * tmp % N
# tmp1-c2e1 = (k22-k4) * q^(e1e2) mod n
tmp2 = (tmp1 - c2e1) * pow(k22 - k4, -1, N) % N
q = GCD(tmp2, N)
p = N // q
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = pow(65537, -1, phi)
m = pow(c, d, N)
print(long_to_bytes(m))
# b'moectf{Sh4!!0w_deeb4t0_P01arnova}'
```

### rsa9

coppersmith变形，题目

```python
from Crypto.Util.number import *
from secret import flag

def get_gift(p, q):
    noise = getPrime(40)
    p, q = p + 2 * noise + 1, q - pow(noise, 2)
    gift = 2024 * (p + q)
    return gift

p = getPrime(512)
q = getPrime(512)
n = p * q
e = 0x10001
m = bytes_to_long(flag)
c = pow(m, e, n)
gift = get_gift(p, q)

print(f'c = {c}')
print(f'n = {n}')
print(f'gift = {gift}')
'''
c = 
n = 
gift = 39547655338591268416024892946343460747211218550535995617642903613170150955997840152715201498906344562997468416098343128362185851706762400674501008847952116336
'''
```

一眼看过去，gift//2024就是给了p+q的高位信息，一开始想copper直接恢复p+q，但是没法确定那个对应的模数N，行不通

[参考博客](https://www.cnblogs.com/SevensNight/p/18766266)，给了一种从未设想的道路，由$p \cdot q = n$得$p \cdot (p+q-p) = n$，然后处理一下不完全正确的(p+q)，把正确的部分提取出来，代入，得到一个关于p的方程，可以解出不完全正确的p，也就是高位正确的p，然后和rsa8一样恢复p就结束了

具体地，(p + q)_new = p + q + 2 * noise + 1 - pow(noise, 2)，noise是40位的，则noise平方是79或80位(记为t位)，2*noise是41位的，注意noise的平方是要减去的，如果不发生借位，那么最多就影响t位，如果发生借位，那么最后完整的p+q右移t位后，实际上少了个1，要补上

另外一点，用不完全的p+q解出来的不完全的p大概低多少位是有问题的呢？这里我只是尝试的方法，就按也是80位去算了

我尝试了t=80，且不借位的情况，可行。然后发现t=80，且借位的情况，也行，exp如下，区别在于第7行有无''+1' (t=79的两种情况也都行，用下面这组参数都能出结果)

```python
from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes

c = 
n = 
gift = 39547655338591268416024892946343460747211218550535995617642903613170150955997840152715201498906344562997468416098343128362185851706762400674501008847952116336
gift1 = gift // 2024
paddq_high = (gift1 >> 80) + 1

PR.<x> = PolynomialRing(RealField(1000))
paddq = paddq_high << 80
f = x*(paddq - x) - n
roots = f.roots()
p1 = Integer(round(roots[0][0]))

PR.<x> = PolynomialRing(Zmod(n))
f = ((p1>>80) <<80) + x
res = f.small_roots(X=2^85, beta=0.4) # 要比80大，实测最小81也行
p = ((p1>>80) <<80) + res[0]
q = n // int(p)
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = pow(65537, -1, phi)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print(long_to_bytes(int(m)))
# b'flag{afhkhkahkjafshkjafshfahkjfa}'
```

一些个人理解：coppersmith对于参数的调整是挺重要的，有时候思路没问题，参数不够准就跑不出结果，但是具体怎么调，我目前也只会去多试一试（ 体现在这个题目里，主要要去调后半部分的f中p1移位的数量和根的上界）上面是一个能出结果的参数，下面给了一些其他也可行的参数

```
# 往小调一点也可以
f = ((p1>>75) <<75) + x
res = f.small_roots(X=2^80, beta=0.4)
# 往大调基本都没问题
f = ((p1>>100) <<100) + x
res = f.small_roots(X=2^100, beta=0.4)
```

从结果上来看，不完全的p+q解出来的不完全的p的错误位相比是较少的
